system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes in dressing-gown or ulster with Dr. Watson in frock-coat, standing on the manor lawn beside Helen Stoner in high-necked plain dress and shawl","action":"Holmes speaks earnestly while gesturing toward the distant village inn; Miss Stoner listens with hand resting on his sleeve, Watson watches in astonished silence","setting":"Stoke Moran manor grounds in rural Surrey, damp lawn, bare trees and hedgerows, the village inn's lights faintly visible across the fields","secondaryElements":"Manor windows of the bedroom above, shutters half-open, a single lamp not yet lit; mild overcast sky with a damp rural chill; plain country clothing","mood":"Grave, tense and intimate, with restrained urgency and dry gaslit foreboding","timeOfDay":"Late afternoon fading toward dusk","composition":"Medium two-shot framed on the three figures with the manor facade rising behind and the inn's distant glimmer across the fields at the edge"}
